name: Bluesky (bsky.app) image CDN
tier_rationale: Same operator and tier as the Bluesky AppView provider (bluesky.json, batch p2-G05-1): Bluesky Social, PBC, an established company with published terms of service and a privacy policy (A8 trusted). The P114 module's lowest provider tier stays community (Codeberg).

reliability.justification: Serves the avatar image the account owner uploaded; the image itself says nothing about who uploaded it.

avatars.title: Bluesky avatar images cdn.bsky.app/img/avatar/... (one GET per avatar URL already found on a profile, P114)

terms.quote: Avatar correlation (dHash) + Gravatar/unavatar avatar hashes: council-1 approved, provider_tier community, terms open (P114).

avatars.notes: Public avatar images referenced by public Bluesky profiles (AT Protocol blobs). Fetched once per avatar URL per case, hashed in memory (SHA-256 + whole-image dHash) and discarded: ttl 0, never cached or stored (P114 cond 4). The CDN sends no Last-Modified header (measured 2026-11-26).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G05-2 (avatar_correlation, P114). The Bluesky public API host public.api.bsky.app is not part of this provider: a batch that needs it adds it with an extension fragment (bsky_app__<suffix>.json).
